name: Cream

whyMatters.en: London power trio formed in 1966: Eric Clapton, Jack Bruce, and Ginger Baker. Blues improvisation at high volume across Fresh Cream, Disraeli Gears, and Wheels of Fire (1966–68).
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦三件套，1966 年成立：Eric Clapton、Jack Bruce、Ginger Baker。1966–68 年在 Fresh Cream、Disraeli Gears、Wheels of Fire 上以高音量做蓝调即兴。

lyricQuotes: It's getting near dawn / When lights close their tired eyes
In the white room with black curtains near the station

shortBio.en: Clapton / Bruce / Baker trio, 1966–68. Sunshine of Your Love and the live Crossroads are the core tracks.
shortBio.zh: Clapton / Bruce / Baker 三人组，1966–68。核心曲目为 Sunshine of Your Love 与现场 Crossroads。

body.en:
Cream formed in London in July 1966 after Clapton left the Yardbirds. Jack Bruce played bass and sang; Ginger Baker played drums. There was no second guitarist.

Fresh Cream (1966), Disraeli Gears (1967), and Wheels of Fire (1968) are the main albums. Sunshine of Your Love (1967) and the live Crossroads (Winterland, on Wheels of Fire) are the best-known tracks. The band ended in November 1968 after about two years and four US Top 10 albums.
body.zh:
Cream 于 1966 年 7 月在伦敦成立，此前 Clapton 离开 Yardbirds。Jack Bruce 弹贝斯并唱歌，Ginger Baker 打鼓。没有第二吉他手。

主要专辑为 Fresh Cream（1966）、Disraeli Gears（1967）与 Wheels of Fire（1968）。最知名曲目为 Sunshine of Your Love（1967）与现场 Crossroads（Winterland，收录于 Wheels of Fire）。乐队于 1968 年 11 月结束，约两年内有四张美国 Top 10 专辑。

note.en: From Disraeli Gears. Descending minor-key riff; Clapton wah lead.
note.zh: 出自 Disraeli Gears。下行小调 riff；Clapton wah 主音。

note.en: From Wheels of Fire. 5/4 verse into 4/4 chorus; Baker tom fills.
note.zh: 出自 Wheels of Fire。5/4 主歌接 4/4 副歌；Baker 的 tom 过门。

note.en: Live Robert Johnson cover from Winterland; Clapton solo at trio tempo.
note.zh: Winterland 现场的 Robert Johnson 翻唱；三件套速度下的 Clapton solo。

body.en:
Clapton left the Yardbirds over pop direction and joined Bruce and Baker. The trio debuted at the Twelfth Night Ball in London in July 1966.

With no second guitarist, each player carried lead weight. Blues covers and originals shared the set from the start.

Fresh Cream (1966) recorded the live rave-up approach before denser studio production.
body.zh:
Clapton 因流行方向离开 Yardbirds，与 Bruce、Baker 组队。1966 年 7 月在伦敦 Twelfth Night Ball 首演。

没有第二吉他手，三人各自承担主音重量。蓝调翻唱与原创从一开始就并列于曲目中。

Fresh Cream（1966）在更密的录音室制作之前，记录了现场 rave-up 写法。

body.en:
Disraeli Gears (1967), produced with Felix Pappalardi, added wah, Leslie cabinet, and tighter song forms to the trio’s blues base.

Sunshine of Your Love opens on Bruce’s descending riff; Clapton’s solo uses wah as a tone filter.

Strange Brew and Tales of Brave Ulysses show studio psychedelic effects while keeping blues root notes.
body.zh:
Disraeli Gears（1967）由 Felix Pappalardi 参与制作，在三件套蓝调基础上加入 wah、Leslie 音箱与更紧的歌曲结构。

Sunshine of Your Love 以 Bruce 的下行 riff 开场；Clapton 的 solo 用 wah 作音色滤波。

Strange Brew 与 Tales of Brave Ulysses 使用录音室迷幻效果，同时保留蓝调根音。

body.en:
Wheels of Fire (1968) mixes studio tracks and live sides. White Room moves from a 5/4 verse into a 4/4 chorus.

Crossroads, recorded live at Winterland, is a fast Robert Johnson cover; Clapton’s solo is a frequently referenced guitar take from the period.

Internal conflict and volume disputes ended the band in November 1968. Two years; four US Top 10 albums.
body.zh:
Wheels of Fire（1968）混录音室曲目与现场面。White Room 从 5/4 主歌进入 4/4 副歌。

Crossroads 录于 Winterland 现场，是速度较快的 Robert Johnson 翻唱；Clapton 的 solo 是这一时期常被提到的吉他演奏。

内部矛盾与音量争执使乐队于 1968 年 11 月结束。两年；四张美国 Top 10 专辑。

body.en: From Disraeli Gears (1967). Bruce’s descending minor-key riff; Clapton wah lead over Baker’s tom pattern.
body.zh: 出自 Disraeli Gears（1967）。Bruce 的下行小调 riff；Clapton wah 主音，Baker 通鼓型。

body.en: Studio track from Wheels of Fire. Time-signature shift from 5/4 verse to 4/4 chorus; Baker tom fills.
body.zh: Wheels of Fire 录音室曲目。拍号从 5/4 主歌切到 4/4 副歌；Baker 的 tom 过门。

body.en: Live Robert Johnson cover from Winterland, issued on Wheels of Fire. Trio tempo; Clapton solo is the main focus.
body.zh: Winterland 现场的 Robert Johnson 翻唱，收录于 Wheels of Fire。三件套速度；重点是 Clapton solo。

interviewQuotes.text: It was three virtuosos trying not to step on each other—and often failing gloriously.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Eric Clapton

interviewQuotes.text: We were a blues band that got too loud and too long.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jack Bruce

note.en: Only studio lineup. Fresh Cream through Wheels of Fire.
note.zh: 唯一录音室阵容。从 Fresh Cream 到 Wheels of Fire。

note.en: Descending riff and Baker tom pattern from Disraeli Gears.
note.zh: 出自 Disraeli Gears 的下行 riff 与 Baker 通鼓型。

note.en: Short-lived trio; high-volume blues improvisation at album and live scale.
note.zh: 短命三人组；专辑与现场规模的高音量蓝调即兴。
